rule: Do not count these publications as independent replications; exact component matching remains a source-registration/governance review task.
One-day and one-week experiments remain distinct contrasts; source reused for direct belief and reasoning does not add independent evidence. Broader science correction differs in estimand.
Same Tversky/Kahneman work in different canonical source records; preserve IDs but do not count twice. No canonical register repair.

Reused SRC-433 after full-register title detection. Candidate metadata records publisher authors; canonical attribution conflict remains visible and unmodified. Provisional number 0006 must not be reassigned.
Reuse canonical SRC112; provisional number 0008 is retired, never reassigned. Conceptual critique is not empirical causal evidence.
Same framework paper, no empirical causal replication; preserve both canonical IDs.
2006 psychometric paper reuses N149 CET trial and adds N199; not two independent replications of the 2003 intervention effect.

Bigsby reports 54% of Tannenbaum sample included and 15 new group comparisons. Six-study factorial behavioral review differs from broad fear outcomes; successful-manipulation selection differs from all risk-message trials. No pooling/independence claim.
Four of seven legitimacy evaluations in Mazerolle 2013 are from the RISE conferencing experiment. Do not count seven independent replications or transfer trust/compliance outcomes to legitimacy.

Hartgerink review search ended 2013 and excludes manipulation checks; 2022/2025 primary findings postdate it. Do not count the broad pooled outcome as an additional exact exclusion-rating replication.
Different feedback comparisons, populations and follow-up windows. No pooled effect or independent component efficacy; indirect/reverse mediation and downstream null remain separate.
Preserve prior SOC-F07 duplicate-component flag: SRC509 bundles Centola 2010 (also SRC235) with a separate review. This is not two replications or generic evidence of trust/norm perception.
